records.summary: Nasrin Armand, a prosecutor and widow, is trying to rebuild life for herself and her son Mahyar. In episode 1 her son's therapist, Khosrow Shahabi, takes her to the Caspian shore and insists on hypnotizing her. After she agrees and closes her eyes, he says he will enter her unconscious and take her five years ahead. Public plot pages establish that she already has a son; they do not confirm pregnancy or a child with Khosrow by the end of the 22-episode season.

records.title: Komisarz Alex — "W hipnozie"
records.orientation: TV crime-episode · Komisarz Alex season 3, series episode 36 · 2013 · dir. Robert Wichrowski / Krzysztof Lang · about 44–60 min depending on listing
records.character: Aneta, an adult woman, fiancée of the murder victim
records.hypnotist: Gawryłow, who runs purported healing hypnosis sessions for the seriously ill, is the only hypnotist identified in the case; official episode synopses state Aneta is found in a hypnotic state and is later used in a police sting after being partly woken from hypnosis, without a verbatim sentence that names him as the person who hypnotized her
records.mechanism: Literal hypnosis: Aneta wakes beside her stabbed fiancé with no memory and is found to be in a hypnotic state; police investigate hypnotists and trace Gawryłow's healing seances, including the victim's cancer-ill mother as a patient.
records.summary: Aneta, a young adult woman, wakes in her fiancé's bed and finds him dead with a knife in his back. There is no sign of a break-in or fight, and she remembers nothing. Police determine she is in a state of hypnosis. They look into other similar cases and at people with hypnotic abilities, and find Gawryłow, who holds special hypnosis sessions that are supposed to restore the seriously ill. One of his patients is the victim's mother, who has cancer and intended to leave him her estate; her son had opposed that, which may be why he was killed. With no hard proof, the police plan a sting using Aneta, who has been partly woken from hypnosis.
records.fit_note: LITERAL HYPNOSIS of an adult woman (hypnotist can be anyone). Distinct episode work, identity exact title + year (2013). Existing categories only: crime, medical, adult-hypnosis.
records.relationship: Aneta is the victim's fiancée, not his wife. The victim's mother is also a female hypnosis patient of Gawryłow (cancer treatment seances).

She seeks his help for throat pain through hypnotic sessions; the hypnosis brings out a strong feeling between them, even though she is already engaged to another man.
